title: TUI relay request leaves out marks on items no longer open
findings_note: s285 gate 2026-10-17: marks on items that become done or retired mid-session still go into the request; at 1000+ visible rows `[x]` over a 4-digit queue number leaves one digit showing
boundary: **Not in this slice:** persisting marks, changing the range rule s285 set, or a mark column.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s285's marks are session-only and keyed by item. When a marked item becomes done or retired while the TUI is open, the request overlay still names it. The `[x]` marker also overwrites only three cells of the queue-number slot, so a four-digit number leaves a digit visible.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: drop (or flag) marks whose item is no longer offered by the queue before composing the request; pad `[x]` to the queue-number width.
- `tests/test_tui.py`; `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch them go red.
2. Filter marks at request time; pad the marker.
3. CHANGELOG; mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
